以我上传的照片作为精确的身份参考。100% 保留我的面部——完全一致的面部结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、发型和自然肤色。绝对不要换脸、美颜、人工美白或任何面部修改。

将我置于一个令人屏息的当代建筑艺术装置之中，其中包含巨大的雕塑几何结构、弧形建筑墙面、独特的悬浮元素以及美妙的对比色彩。环境应看起来像真实、高端的建筑展览现场，而不是幻想世界或数字生成的世界。

**服装：**
一件剪裁精美的高品质深酒红色宽松西装外套、一件优雅的象牙白内搭衬衫、完美合体的炭灰色长裤，以及简约而考究的皮质鞋子。不戴腕表。不佩戴多余的珠宝。

捕捉我自然地坐在一张非传统造型的雕塑建筑长凳上，一只手臂随意搭着，另一只手放松地放在膝盖附近。身体略微背向镜头，面部直视镜头，神情平静而自信。展现毫不费力的个性，绝对不要夸张的模特姿势。

HELD BREATH

A little of how I made HELD BREATH.

I started with the character in AI Influencer, added the swimming cap in Nano Banana Pro, then built the bathroom frame around her. I wanted the emotion to come through her eyes, her posture and the space around her.

Character prompt

“Create a photorealistic character reference sheet of an adult woman in her late twenties. Include a front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait and a full-length standing view of the same woman. Pale skin with visible pores, faint freckles, softly flushed cheeks, light eyebrows, blue-grey eyes, a delicate oval face and natural pink lips. Very short light-blonde hair. Her expression is quiet and emotionally withdrawn, with a steady gaze and relaxed facial muscles. Slim build and natural proportions. She wears an opaque, pale blush-pink one-piece swimsuit. Soft diffused studio light, a plain warm ivory background and realistic skin texture. Keep her facial structure and proportions consistent across both views.”

Swimming-cap edit prompt

“Use the supplied character portrait as the identity reference. Add a fitted vintage ivory swimming cap with raised floral petals molded into matte rubber. The cap follows the shape of her head, covers her hair completely and has a softly defined edge along her forehead. Preserve her facial proportions, eye colour, freckles and natural skin texture. Keep the pale pink swimsuit visible at the shoulders. Create a front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait with soft light and fine photographic detail.”

Bathroom-frame prompt

“Create a single photorealistic 4:3 cinematic frame. Use the approved capped portrait as the woman’s identity reference. Place her in a sparse vintage bathing room with square ivory ceramic tiles, a continuous muted aqua tile band, an ivory enamel bathtub with a pale aqua rim, chrome taps and a simple ivory privacy curtain.

The adult woman sits curled at the near end of the bathtub, knees drawn close to her chest, forearms resting across them and her head lowered toward her arms. Her eyes remain partially visible. She wears the same opaque blush-pink swimsuit and ivory floral swimming cap.

Place one sage-grey circular bubble wand with a short handle on the tub rim within reach. A shallow layer of water and a little soap foam sit inside the bath. Keep the air clear at this opening moment.

Compose her toward the left of the frame, leaving generous empty space to the right. Soft daylight enters through a frosted window on the left, creating gentle shadows and restrained reflections on the enamel. Use a 50mm spherical-lens perspective, enough depth of field to read the room, subtle film grain and a cool ivory-and-aqua palette. Preserve natural skin tones, believable anatomy, straight tile lines and the same facial identity.”

The opening frame gave me the setting and mood. From there, I developed the tears, the breath and the bubble through the video shots.
